Poetry Slam

Wednesday 30 September 2026, 7:30pm

Fixture Hall, 1 Example Street, West End QLD 4101

Eight poets, three rounds, one winner chosen by the room. Sign-up on the night; three-minute limit; no props, no music. Part of the hall's spring programme; see the full list on this page.

$10. Doors open thirty minutes before the listed time. The hall is wheelchair accessible from the Example Street entrance.
